description: Researcher-derived May 2014 binary rendering of the literal p56 printed digest; not independently authored content or the unknown AN END page.
verification: bytes.fromhex(target_hex) has byte length 64, SHA-256 source_sha256, and git blob-object SHA-1 source_git_blob_sha1 (SHA1 of b'blob 64\0' + bytes).
limitations: No original target web page, hash algorithm, independently authenticated server HTTP bytes, or solution. Git commit dates are self-reported Git metadata, not trusted external timestamps.
provenance_note: Earliest first-parent 'page 56' commit added 56.txt and 56.bin simultaneously; later relocation to stage11/56.bin retained identical blob. Preserve dependency, not independent witness.
derivative_assessment: Same earliest commit introduced 56.txt containing exact five original printed digest lines and 56.bin containing their binary hex decode, with README xxd -r -p workflow for another numbered text. 56.bin is a conversion of printed literal target, not an independently captured target-page preimage or independent digest witness.
